title: Navimower 0.5.0-beta27

## Restore command history in Download diagnostics

Fixed a privacy-filter collision introduced in beta26: the generic support-export filter intentionally removes the key `recent`, which also hid the command-response history.

- Export recent Mow, Pause, Dock and Resume command results as `control_command_outcomes.recent_commands`.
- Keep the latest result in `control_command_outcomes.latest`.
- Retain the existing limit of 12 recent in-memory commands per mower, with only status metadata included.
- Leave the generic privacy filter in place for private user-authored recent content.
- Add a regression test using synthetic Mow and Dock commands to verify that both survive diagnostics sanitization, along with an empty-history check.

No change to commands, command polling, mower state, gate automations or Map Card. Because history is in-memory, new entries are recorded after installing this update; previously filtered entries are not recovered by upgrading.
